evidence.observation: Purge brought exhaust O2 down from 28765 to 15 ppm; it stayed at about 5-7 ppm afterwards
Thermocouple tracked the ramp setpoint to within about 1 °C
Brief overshoot to 760.8 °C at the start of growth, then settled at 750.0 °C
Heater power steady at about 45% during the hold, which fits holding temperature rather than ramping
Ar at 100 sccm, matching setpoint; pressure steady at about 3.02-3.06 Torr
Controller status stayed 'running' and readings keep changing, so the data is not stale

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample yet, so there is no evidence on whether the material grew. No normal-run reference values (ref) were provided to compare against.
